title: Develop a Product Plan
not_for: A build specification or promising expansion without evidence gates.
input_gate: Sequence customer outcomes and dependencies. If consumption evidence is missing, keep expansion conditional rather than claiming readiness.

roadmap.outcome: Owners complete the second billing cycle
roadmap.evidence_gate: Second-cycle retention improves without more founder hours

deferred.reason: Different buying motion and support burden
deferred.revisit_trigger: Reliable repeat use and positive contribution in the current segment

example_note: A roadmap remains useful before all hypotheses are proven if commitments are conditional and resources are bounded.
failure_case: Features with no outcome, dependency, evidence gate, or owner fail completion.
